exposure: lactation period (first, second, third week after delivery)
cohort: 80 mothers of infants who were hospitalized in the Department of Perinatology/NICU at Sardjito Hospital, Yogyakarta.
finding: There were no significant differences in macronutrient and caloric content between preterm and full term human milk during the first three weeks postpartum, although fat and protein content significantly changed in both groups between the first and third weeks.
